data.body: **[P1] Make the SDK own the inline-versus-reference decision.** The offloader decides before the SDK encodes its envelope, so it cannot account for escaping, ownership metadata, digests, or previews when implementing `OVERFLOW`. A near-limit value can therefore be returned inline and exceed the checkpoint limit after encoding. Have the SDK encode and measure the inline candidate before forcing external storage, or extend the contract with an exact byte budget/force-external mechanism and revalidate the final envelope.
